meta.title: Prompt Picker
meta.description: Composer multi-select prompt picker: check several prompts to inject in order, each scoped to main / sub agents or both; the built-in Full Throttle row is editable too (restoring its default text returns it to config), a shared add/edit dialog joins the inline pencil, and rows delete one by one or all at once.

actions.deleteBody: This cannot be undone, and the row is unchecked too.
actions.clearAllTip: Delete every saved prompt (the built-in row stays)
